Name: Donkeys
Author: omena007
Description:
This mod adds donkeys as farm animals to Marnie's shop. They need a Big Barn and will give you milk very 4 days (donkeys don't produce much milk which makes it rare). Donkey milk is legendary for beauty and health effects. You can use it to make beauty cream by putting 1 milk to oil maker or to make infamous Pule Cheese [i](magareći sir [/i]made in Serbia, the rarest and most expensive cheese) by putting 3 donkey milks into a cheese press.

[size=2]New: Donkeys also provide calming company for the farmer. When you have achieved two hearts friendship with a donkey it will come to your farmer and heal them. This feature needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25328]Extra Animal Configs[/url] which is a soft requirement for the mod.[/size]

[size=2]There's a[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538?tab=description] Animal Husbandry[/url] file for the donkeys which adds donkey meat and two recipes. The recipes are available at Travellers cart and are unlocked by shipping donkey meat.[/size]
